question: Does default feature evolution improve solutions beyond the initial population?
reproduction_script:
"""Measure whether feature-search generations improve on the initial population."""

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from sklearn.base import clone
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer, load_digits, make_classification
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

from sklearn_genetic import GAFeatureSelectionCV


work = Path(".agent-runs/performance-v2")
datasets = {
    "breast": load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True),
    "digits": load_digits(return_X_y=True),
    "synthetic": make_classification(
        n_samples=800, n_features=20, n_informative=8, n_redundant=4, random_state=19
    ),
}
with threadpool_limits(limits=1), (work / "feature-progress.jsonl").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    for dataset, (X, y) in datasets.items():
        for seed in range(991, 999):
            train, test = train_test_split(
                np.arange(len(y)), test_size=0.25, stratify=y, random_state=seed
            )
            Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = X[train], X[test], y[train], y[test]
            folds = list(StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=seed).split(Xtr, ytr))
            model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), SVC(kernel="rbf", C=10))
            started = time.perf_counter()
            search = GAFeatureSelectionCV(
                clone(model),
                cv=folds,
                scoring="accuracy",
                max_features=X.shape[1] // 2,
                population_size=8,
                generations=4,
                random_state=seed,
                n_jobs=1,
                verbose=False,
                error_score="raise",
            ).fit(Xtr, ytr)
            seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
            scores = np.asarray(search.cv_results_["mean_test_score"], dtype=float)
            masks = [np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool) for mask in search.cv_results_["features"]]
            assert len(scores) == len(masks) == 72
            initial_index = max(range(8), key=lambda index: (scores[index], -masks[index].sum()))
            initial_mask = masks[initial_index]
            initial_model = clone(model).fit(Xtr[:, initial_mask], ytr)
            final_mask = search.support_
            row = dict(
                dataset=dataset,
                seed=seed,
                seconds=seconds,
                candidate_cv_calls=search.fit_stats_["cross_validate_calls"],
                initial_cv=float(scores[initial_index]),
                final_cv=float(np.nanmax(scores)),
                initial_holdout=float(
                    accuracy_score(yte, initial_model.predict(Xte[:, initial_mask]))
                ),
                final_holdout=float(
                    accuracy_score(yte, search.best_estimator_.predict(Xte[:, final_mask]))
                ),
                initial_features=int(initial_mask.sum()),
                final_features=int(final_mask.sum()),
                history_best=[float(np.ravel(value)[0]) for value in search.history["fitness_best"]],
            )
            stream.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
            stream.flush()
            print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
summary_script:
"""Freeze feature-selection quality gains from generation zero to generation four."""

import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import math
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer, load_digits, make_classification
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, train_test_split


work = Path(".agent-runs/performance-v2")
rows = [
    json.loads(line)
    for line in (work / "feature-progress.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
]
expected = {
    (dataset, seed)
    for dataset in ("breast", "digits", "synthetic")
    for seed in range(991, 999)
}
by_key = {(row["dataset"], row["seed"]): row for row in rows}
assert len(rows) == len(by_key) == len(expected) == 24 and set(by_key) == expected
for row in rows:
    assert 0 < row["candidate_cv_calls"] <= 72
    assert len(row["history_best"]) == 5
    assert math.isclose(row["initial_cv"], row["history_best"][0], abs_tol=1e-12)
    assert math.isclose(row["final_cv"], row["history_best"][-1], abs_tol=1e-12)
    assert all(left <= right + 1e-12 for left, right in zip(row["history_best"], row["history_best"][1:]))
    assert 1 <= row["initial_features"] <= {"breast": 15, "digits": 32, "synthetic": 10}[row["dataset"]]
    assert 1 <= row["final_features"] <= {"breast": 15, "digits": 32, "synthetic": 10}[row["dataset"]]
    assert 0 <= row["initial_holdout"] <= 1 and 0 <= row["final_holdout"] <= 1

summary = []
for dataset in ("breast", "digits", "synthetic"):
    subset = [by_key[(dataset, seed)] for seed in range(991, 999)]
    heldout_deltas = [row["final_holdout"] - row["initial_holdout"] for row in subset]
    summary.append(
        dict(
            dataset=dataset,
            seeds=list(range(991, 999)),
            initial_cv_mean=statistics.mean(row["initial_cv"] for row in subset),
            final_cv_mean=statistics.mean(row["final_cv"] for row in subset),
            cv_delta_mean=statistics.mean(row["final_cv"] - row["initial_cv"] for row in subset),
            initial_holdout_mean=statistics.mean(row["initial_holdout"] for row in subset),
            final_holdout_mean=statistics.mean(row["final_holdout"] for row in subset),
            heldout_delta_mean=statistics.mean(heldout_deltas),
            worst_heldout_delta=min(heldout_deltas),
            heldout_wins=sum(delta > 0 for delta in heldout_deltas),
            heldout_ties=sum(delta == 0 for delta in heldout_deltas),
            heldout_losses=sum(delta < 0 for delta in heldout_deltas),
            cv_improved=sum(row["final_cv"] > row["initial_cv"] for row in subset),
            generation_best_mean=[
                statistics.mean(row["history_best"][generation] for row in subset)
                for generation in range(5)
            ],
            initial_features_mean=statistics.mean(row["initial_features"] for row in subset),
            final_features_mean=statistics.mean(row["final_features"] for row in subset),
            seconds_mean=statistics.mean(row["seconds"] for row in subset),
        )
    )

datasets = {
    "breast": load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True),
    "digits": load_digits(return_X_y=True),
    "synthetic": make_classification(
        n_samples=800, n_features=20, n_informative=8, n_redundant=4, random_state=19
    ),
}
split_sha256 = {}
for dataset, (_, y) in datasets.items():
    for seed in range(991, 999):
        train, test = train_test_split(
            np.arange(len(y)), test_size=0.25, stratify=y, random_state=seed
        )
        folds = list(StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=seed).split(train, y[train]))
        arrays = [train, test] + [array for fold in folds for array in fold]
        split_sha256[f"{dataset}/{seed}"] = hashlib.sha256(
            b"".join(np.asarray(array, dtype="<i8").tobytes() for array in arrays)
        ).hexdigest()

source_paths = [
    Path("sklearn_genetic/genetic_search.py"),
    Path("sklearn_genetic/algorithms.py"),
    Path("sklearn_genetic/population.py"),
]
payload = dict(
    question="Does default feature evolution improve solutions beyond the initial population?",
    source_commit=subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    settings=dict(
        datasets=list(datasets),
        seeds=list(range(991, 999)),
        holdout_fraction=0.25,
        cv_folds=3,
        population_size=8,
        generations=4,
        proposal_budget=72,
        max_features="half",
        model="StandardScaler plus SVC(kernel=rbf, C=10)",
        cpu_threads=1,
    ),
    environment={
        "python": platform.python_version(),
        **{
            name: importlib.metadata.version(name)
            for name in ("numpy", "scikit-learn", "scipy", "deap")
        },
    },
    source_sha256={str(path).replace("\\", "/"): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in source_paths},
    split_sha256=split_sha256,
    raw_sha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
    summary=summary,
    raw=rows,
    reproduction_script=(work / "feature-progress.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
    summary_script=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
)
destination = Path("benchmarks/results/performance-v2/feature-progress.json")
destination.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
